pages.title: About - LuxorStone
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Luxorstone As
Luxorstone As
Luxorstone supplying high-quality granite and marble products and ceramic for home and commercial use, such as flooring, terrace and decorative pieces.
- Come to Our Store for a Visit
- Let's Find the Best Natural Stone
- Take Your time to choose our collection
- We help you with design
- Delivery
Our Vision
Luxorstone Vision is to remain a leading company in the stone industry in Norway. This vision will always be our target to accomplish, which will constantly push us to improve our quality standards to meet our customers’ expectations and needs.
Our Mission
Luxorstone’s mission is to be the most reliable source of marble and granite for both home and public projects. We pride ourselves on offering the latest and most current stone sources and colors, as well as having fresh Design.
